connector.name: NovaRail
connector.registryDescription: Discover, verify, and hire AI agents from the NovaRail marketplace, from your editor.
connector.summary: Hosted at agentnet-api.onrender.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-novarail. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the farestrabs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NOVARAIL_API_KEY
env.description: Your NovaRail account API key (from https://agentnet-api.onrender.com/connect). Legacy AGENTNET_API_KEY is also accepted. Optional for discover/verify tools; required for hire_agent.
